The powerful deluge of blood rips through the Sinners like blades through paper.
罪人们完全无力抵抗，被强大的血流冲击得支离破碎。

What shame.
多可惜啊。

You used to make me lances that were much more graceful than this.
你曾为我制作的长枪不会如此粗糙。

Yet... this holds more than enough power to destroy that feeble timepiece of yours.
不过……要打碎你那个脆弱的钟表也足够了。

He launches a lance of blood at me with his inhuman strength.
那支血做成的长枪向我飞来。

I instinctively knew that the spear was to be my demise.
无需思考，也能感觉到那长枪中蕴含着的毁灭性力量。

And... I couldn't help but avert my eyes from the impending doom.
在万事皆休的预感之中，我低下了头。

I guess... we never had a chance to begin with...
果然……是无法战胜的敌人吗……

Didst thou not say...
冒险结束的时间……

I look up at the sudden upbeat, cheerful voice.
我在这明朗的声音中抬起头来。

There stood Sancho, standing tall even as her body was torn by the brutal, sanguine lance.
看见了桑丘那满身疮痍，却不曾屈服的身影。

Unbroken and bold, unyielding before the First Kindred's insurmountable might.
挡住了血枪的她威风凛凛地站在前方。

... that thou shalt decide the time for me to come to my senses?
不是要……由汝来决定吗……

It's the same back I always saw scampering toward inevitable trouble whenever something interesting was happening.
那个遇到有趣事情会第一时间跑出去的……

The same silhouette of the troublemaker who always appeared so small to me.
经常惹麻烦的小小身影映入我的眼帘。

But at this very moment, her familiar and reassuring shadow felt so much larger—infinitely larger as she stood in front of me.
那熟悉，却又似乎无比高大的身姿，

So I call to her in a name I never thought I would get another chance to repeat.
令我不由得再次说出了那个仿佛再也不能叫出的名字。

<Don... Quixote.>
<堂……吉诃德。>

It is unfortunate that you now protect them with your back that once shielded me.
真可惜啊，那曾经守护着我的背脊现在却守护着别人。

... But I am proud that you stopped my lance.
但我很骄傲，你挡住了我的长枪。

Yet... what will you do now, Sancho?
可是……你现在打算怎么做呢，桑丘。

Your strength must be spent after such a mighty feat.
你已经没有余力阻止我了吧。

I intend to fight still. This is not the end.
我会继续战斗下去。还远远没有结束。

... Even if it is not by my hand, even if it is not this day when your adventure ends...
……即使我不能在这里终结你的冒险。

... this sickness will inevitably drag you off that steed.
你的病也终有一天会让你从马鞍上跌落下来。

I couldn't see Don Quixote's expression from where I was.
我没能看到堂吉诃德闻言露出了何种表情。

Even still...
尽管这样……

I know that.
我明白。

Even still.
即便如此。

... though to some, I may only appear to be playing a character...
即便这对某些人来说可能只是一出戏剧……

... though I may never truly reach my destination...
就算我可能永远也无法到达目的地……

She was incandescent, like a brilliant star twinkling in the night sky.
她那灿烂的背影就如星星一般。

... should I persevere to walk the journey of my own choosing...
即便如此，我也要朝着生之所向前进……

... and continue this tale...
如果这个故事继续下去……

That very brilliance compelled me to reach out and hope.
我不知不觉地想要伸手触摸那个背影。

Then that shall be my... your dream.
那就将是我，与你的梦想。

Let that star...
那颗星……

... shine ever brighter...
希望它更加明亮……

<I will light your path.>
<我将照亮前路。>

<So don't hesitate. Go—walk the journey of your own choosing.>
<所以尽管去吧。按照你所想的方向。>

... I shan't be long.
……吾去去就回。
